seoTitle: RUSD Calendar 2026–27 | Racine Unified School District
seoDescription: RUSD’s 2026–27 school year starts September 1 for grades 1–12, with a staggered 5K opening. See breaks, early-release Wednesdays, Early Learning dates, and official PDFs.
heroSummary: RUSD students in grades 1–12 begin school Tuesday, September 1, 2026. The district uses a staggered September 1–4 start for 5K. For 2026–27, RUSD also has 25 one-hour early-release Wednesdays. Winter Recess runs December 23–January 1, Spring Recess runs March 26–April 2, and the published last day is June 10, subject to weather-related changes.
verificationBadgeText: Checked against official RUSD sources on August 13, 2026.
calendarNotes: Grades 1-12 begin September 1, while 5K uses orientation and surname cohorts through September 4. RUSD introduced one-hour early release on 25 selected Wednesdays and added six minutes to regular school days to offset the lost instructional time. October 2, October 29, November 13, and February 5 close school only for K-5, while grades 6-12 remain in session. March 10 is the grade 11 ACT day; K-10 and grade 12 do not attend. The Early Learning track includes extra Family Engagement closures on September 18, February 19, March 5, and April 23, and it treats some K-5-only dates as closures for all students on that track. Goodland Montessori follows the K-12 district calendar rather than the Early Learning PDF. February 15, May 14, June 10, and June 11 carry asterisks because RUSD may adjust them after inclement weather.
gradingPeriodsDescription: The official PDF prints the end date for each quarter. It does not publish quarter start dates or report-card issue dates, so those fields are not inferred.

calendarFaqs.q: When does RUSD start school in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Grades 1–12 begin Tuesday, September 1, 2026. For 5K, September 1 is family orientation. Students with last names A–L attend September 2, students with last names M–Z attend September 3, and all 5K students attend September 4.

calendarFaqs.q: Which Wednesdays are early release in RUSD for 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: RUSD lists 25 Wednesdays from September 16, 2026, through May 26, 2027. Schools release one hour early, but exact dismissal times vary by school and program.

calendarFaqs.q: When is RUSD Winter Recess in 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Recess runs Wednesday, December 23, 2026, through Friday, January 1, 2027. Students return Monday, January 4.

calendarFaqs.q: Which RUSD students attend school on March 10, 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Grade 11 attends for ACT testing. Students in K–10 and grade 12 do not attend because of professional learning.

calendarFaqs.q: When is RUSD Spring Recess in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Recess runs Friday, March 26, through Friday, April 2, 2027. Students return Monday, April 5.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of school in RUSD for 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: The printed last day is Thursday, June 10, 2027. It carries an asterisk and may be adjusted due to inclement weather; June 11 is a records or contingent-weather day.

calendarFaqs.q: Does RUSD Early Learning follow every K–12 date?
calendarFaqs.a: No. The Early Learning track adds Family Engagement closures and treats several K–5-only dates as closures for its students. Goodland Montessori follows the K–12 calendar instead.

calendarFaqs.q: Which RUSD dates are no-school days for K–5 only?
calendarFaqs.a: Students in K–5 do not attend on October 2, October 29, November 13, and February 5. Students in grades 6–12 remain in session on those dates.

Early Learning differences and the Goodland Montessori exception were checked against the separate English and Spanish program PDFs.
Asterisked dates remain weather-sensitive; contingent dates are excluded from the one-time MySchoolDates .ics export.
